summary: Dominica: actual total recurrent revenue from the 'Actual' column of 12 budget books (FY2011/12, FY2014/15-FY2024/25), and the CBI share of it calculated from the two printed figures (decision 19). FY2012/13 and FY2013/14 are missing: the 2014/15 and 2015/16 books are not stored.

observations.location: PDF p. 3, recurrent revenue budget, total row, column "Actual 2011/12"
observations.notes: Central government recurrent revenue (Ministry of Finance, Commonwealth of Dominica): tax and non-tax revenue including the Citizenship by Investment Programme; grants, loans and other capital receipts are not included. Fiscal year July-June. EC$.

observations.location: PDF p. 3, recurrent revenue budget, Citizenship by Investment Programme row and total row, column "Actual 2011/12"
observations.quote: Citizenship by Investment Programme 17,011,602 / total recurrent revenue 357,081,326 (both column "Actual 2011/12")
observations.notes: Recipe: Citizenship by Investment Programme actual (17,011,602) divided by total recurrent revenue actual (357,081,326), both in column "Actual 2011/12" of the recurrent revenue budget table, times 100, rounded to one decimal (4.764). Both figures are stored as printed rows (cbi_fiscal_revenue and government_recurrent_revenue, same source and period). Share of recurrent revenue: grants and loans are not in the base, the same base the budget books use for their planned percentage. Calculated by us, METHODOLOGY.md decision 19; recalculated independently from the book on 2026-10-14 with the same result.

new_indicators.name: Government recurrent revenue
new_indicators.definition: Total recurrent revenue of the central government in a period (tax and non-tax revenue; excludes grants, loans and capital receipts), as printed. A context figure: the base for CBI shares of revenue.
new_indicators.notes: Added 2026-10-14 for Dominica (budget books). Context figure without a programme.
